scripts.semgrep: docker run --rm --network none -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.172.0 semgrep scan --metrics=off --disable-version-check --scan-unknown-extensions --config semgrep/ $(find migrations lib setup test -type f \( -name '*.mts' -o -name '*.cts' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' -o -name '*.js' \)) migrate-mongo-config.js
scripts.semgrep:ci: docker run --rm --network none -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.172.0 semgrep scan --metrics=off --disable-version-check --scan-unknown-extensions --error --sarif --output semgrep.sarif --config semgrep/ $(find migrations lib setup test -type f \( -name '*.mts' -o -name '*.cts' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' -o -name '*.js' \)) migrate-mongo-config.js
